Contact

ETHERSIM · ethersim.ai — a personal, open-source project

ETHERSIM is built and maintained by one person, in the open. The best way to reach the project — for bugs, ideas, new systems, or questions — is through GitHub.

Report a bug or request a feature

  • From inside the app: open the Learn panel on any system and click ⚠ report — it opens a pre-filled GitHub issue.
  • Directly: open a new issue on GitHub.

Questions, ideas & discussion

Have an idea for a system to add, or a general question? Open an issue at github.com/macncrash/realethersim. Suggestions for new dynamical systems are especially welcome.

Privacy or data requests

See the Privacy & data page for what's collected (very little). For any data question, open a GitHub issue and we'll respond there.

The code

Everything is open source under the MIT License: github.com/macncrash/realethersim. Fork it, run it locally, or explore it in your browser.
